annotator_pool.notice: SIMULATED ANNOTATORS. No human labels were collected. Agreement statistics characterise the generative annotator model in rubricon.annotation.pool, not real annotator behaviour. The measurement machinery is real; the findings are demonstrations, not empirical claims about language models.

trait_definitions.bias: Persistent leniency (+) or harshness (-) offset in rubric points.
trait_definitions.competence: Scales down judgement noise; 1.0 would be a perfect reader of the rubric.
trait_definitions.fatigue_rate: Noise inflation per item completed within a session.
trait_definitions.speed_factor: Relative annotation speed; <1 is slower than the reference pace.
trait_definitions.value_position: Stable stance applied ONLY to dimensions marked contested. This is the variance component that replication cannot reduce.
